title: Readable entity names
responsibility: Keeps canonical recorded code names consistent across catalogs, related units and detail pages; derives readable route screen labels separately.

inputs.name: explorerName.unit
inputs.description: Unit identity, kind and title with optional owned source and declared symbols from the viewed revision.

inputs.name: explorerAppRoute.unit
inputs.description: Unit kind, title and owned files used for the page address.

outputs.name: explorerName
outputs.description: Recorded primary symbol or owned module stem for code units, preserving exact casing. Shared models omit the .types file suffix while keeping their recorded identity and source paths. Route screens retain readable names; absent code metadata retains the explicit readable fallback. No unit ID or route changes.

outputs.name: explorerAppRoute
outputs.description: For page or layout kinds, a slash-prefixed title or the owned +page route address; null for other kinds or no matching route file.
